label: After-hours call (11:15pm) — 2BHK in Wakad
transcript:
Agent: Namaste, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. Before we begin, please note this call is recorded for quality and to help our designers. May I know your name?
Caller: Hi, sorry for calling so late. I'm Sneha Patil.
Agent: No problem at all, Sneha, we're happy to help any time. Which area is your property in?
Caller: Wakad.
Agent: What kind of space is it, and roughly how big?
Caller: 2BHK, around 950 square feet. We want the kitchen and wardrobes done, plus the living room.
Agent: Do you have a budget range in mind?
Caller: Maybe 7 to 8 lakh.
Agent: And your timeline?
Caller: In about three months.
Agent: Thank you. Would you like me to book a consultation, or would you prefer a designer to call you tomorrow?
Caller: Please have someone call me tomorrow afternoon.
Agent: Of course. I've noted that you'd prefer a call tomorrow afternoon, and our team will reach out to you. Thank you for calling Aangan Studio.
